identity.description: Backdoor UID-0 Account Created on the Linux Syslog Feed. The attacker behavior is visible in the Linux host auth/syslog that is forwarded to a Cortex Broker VM syslog applet (parsed into dataset=linux_syslog) — a collector/log-level detection, not the endpoint-agent process feed. CortexSim drives linux_syslog_emitter.py to reproduce the detectable syslog telemetry; no real host is touched.

payload.code:
# Collector/log-level validation — stream shape-true Linux auth/syslog to the lab Broker VM.
COLLECTOR="${BROKER_VM:-192.0.2.9}"
python3 core/eal_simulator/linux_syslog_emitter.py --collector "$COLLECTOR" --phase baseline --baseline-count 40
python3 core/eal_simulator/linux_syslog_emitter.py --collector "$COLLECTOR" --phase attack --which new-local-account

expected_artifacts.description: Linux syslog records for: Backdoor UID-0 Account Created on the Linux Syslog Feed.

xql_queries.name: New UID-0 User Added via useradd
xql_queries.query:
dataset = linux_syslog
| filter process = "useradd" and message contains "UID=0"
| comp count() as adds by host, message
| filter adds >= 1

xql_queries.name: New Account Added to the sudo Group
xql_queries.query:
dataset = linux_syslog
| filter process = "usermod" and message contains "sudo"
| comp count() as c by host
| filter c >= 1
